seasons.name: Storm Cup. Fourth Season
seasons.textTutMain:
Welcome to the [color=#FFC700]Storm Cup![/color]

Five racing modes await you. Take part in races using the featured car or your own, if it matches the class. The cars in the races will be updated every week. For each race you will receive
 Racer Tokens for the shop
 Rating points for the leaderboard
 [color=#2196F3]EXP[/color] for reward tracks if available
 [color=#FFC700]Racer Ticket[/color] Become the best racer of the season and earn [color=#FFC700]unique rewards[/color] for your skill.

Good luck at the start
seasons.textTutModeSelector:
Several racing modes are available to you. The list may change from season to season.

[color=#FFC700]Please note:[/color] the available cars of different [color=#FFC700]classes[/color] may differ from mode to mode. Choose the one where you can show your best result!
seasons.textTutCarSelector:
The race class is determined by the free car of the week — choose it or a suitable car from your property.[color=#FFC700]Firmware[/color] affects characteristics and can move the car into another [color=#FFC700]class[/color].To change the [color=#FFC700]firmware[/color], visit the Tuning Studio and install the one you need.

Please note: not all cars have been assigned a [color=#FFC700]class[/color] yet, and they will not be able to participate in races.

 The list of cars with a [color=#FFC700]class[/color] will be constantly expanded. Stay tuned for updates!

raceGamesList.title: Colossus
raceGamesList.subtitle: Circuit race around the city. Onward to victory!

raceGamesList.title: SPRINT
raceGamesList.subtitle: Classic sprint. Follow the checkpoints and finish faster than everyone else to win

raceGamesList.title: LAP
raceGamesList.subtitle: Classic circuit race. Finish first to win

raceGamesList.title: DRIFT
raceGamesList.subtitle: Score drift points by going into a skid. The one who scores the most points wins

raceGamesList.title: ELIMINATION LAP
raceGamesList.subtitle: Circuit race. After each lap, the last player is eliminated

raceGamesList.title: ELIMINATION SPRINT
raceGamesList.subtitle: A sprint where the one who reaches certain checkpoints last is eliminated
